body:
Hello everyone,

This new release is more a revamp of the internal tools and codebase InstantSearch.js to have a good clean base for the next features and future releases 👍 

**What does it includes?**

* Upgrade of building tools #2240 
* Run prettier and new eslint config on the codebase
* New release script to allow beta version to be released with ease

The main feature of this release was also to allow users using the npm package and a code bundler (webpack, rollup, browserify) to have access to a ES6 modules build that will reduce their final app size a lot.

**What else is included in the release?**

* New section on the usage guide to guide you on how to use the ES6 modules build.
* A guide on how to create a no results page.
* A guide on how to plug [opensearch](http://www.opensearch.org/Home)
* A guide on how to create custom widgets without using a connector
* Added a new showcase section of all the widgets on the documentation
* A guide on how to ingrate with Angular2+

**How can you help?**

We have release beta version of the 2.1.0 that you easily install with `$ npm install instantsearch.js@beta` and try it out.

Send us feedback and issues you have experienced by creating a new issue on this repository.

🚀
